sources.title: Northstar project brief
sources.description: Audience, goals, deliverables, and what a good outcome looks like.
sources.details: Project brief: a welcoming homepage, a strong editorial story and a considered mobile experience. The current task and artifact interactions are kept in this browser tab.

sources.title: Voice & visual direction
sources.description: Thoughtful, clear, human. A shared creative starting point.
sources.details: Keep the voice warm and direct. Give important ideas room to breathe. Use clear headings, useful labels, and imagery that serves the story. Avoid exaggerated claims, fake testimonials, or invented performance metrics.

sources.title: Kickoff conversation
sources.description: Decisions, commitments, and the context behind the work.
sources.details: Alex will share the project brief. Maya will review the homepage direction. Builder will propose a first draft. Reviewer will inspect the exact version. Client content approval and developer release approval are separate steps.

sources.title: The review checklist
sources.description: The small details that make a thoughtful handoff.
sources.details: Check the outcome against acceptance criteria. Inspect the exact artifact version. Confirm keyboard and mobile usability. Keep source references with the result. A statement that work is done is not evidence that it meets the brief.
